watchlist_taxa.note: Kew treats it as introduced in Texas; hold outside the core set unless it becomes locally relevant.

genus_diagnostics.leaves: Simple and often deeply palmately lobed in the species currently curated.
genus_diagnostics.flowers: Funnel/campanulate flowers; white to yellow depending on species, sometimes with a contrasting throat.
genus_diagnostics.androecium: Anthers in Distimake can be strongly twisted/spiral, a useful genus-level character.
genus_diagnostics.fruit: Capsules with persistent/enlarging calyx in several species.
